root_cause_criterion.criterion: After `++it` and before the version parse dereferences `(*it).tokens[0]`, `InternReadFile()` must establish that `it` still differs from `root.children.end()`.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the crashing witness, the iterator has already advanced past the only parsed child, so the missing end-iterator guard is false exactly at the version-read site. The fixed program adds that guard before any dereference.

nodes.state: At the version-parse site, the iterator value equals `root.children.end()`, so the immediately following `(*it).tokens[0].c_str()` dereferences the past-the-end iterator.

edges.relation: The same iterator value observed at the missing-guard checkpoint is reused unchanged by the immediately following version parse.
